name: Medium
summary: A cooperative word-association game where neighboring partners try to say the same connecting word at the same time.
rules_text: Each player holds six word cards from a shared deck built from one fewer set than player count. Three Crystal Ball cards are hidden in the bottom third. On your turn you partner with the left neighbor. Partner plays a card face-up, you play one, both saying the words. You both now think of a single Medium that connects them and on a three-count say it simultaneously. If you say the same idea you earn a First Attempt token. If not, you try again using your two previous guesses as the new pair, not reusing old words. You get up to three attempts with decreasing token values. Then discard played cards, both draw to six, reshuffling crystal balls handling. Play proceeds clockwise. When the third Crystal Ball is drawn, finish the round so each partnership had equal turns. Score shared tokens per adjacent pair, plus unused powers, most points wins.
